description: This file defines the Registry class for managing key-value pairs of objects in the OpenCart system. It provides methods to get, set, check, and unset registry entries, enabling global object storage and retrieval within the application.

classes.name: Registry
classes.description: A class that implements a registry pattern, allowing storage and retrieval of object references by key.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Magic getter to retrieve a value from the registry by key.

methods.name: __set
methods.description: Magic setter to store a value in the registry with a specified key.

methods.name: __isset
methods.description: Magic isset to check if a key exists in the registry.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieve an object associated with the key from the registry.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Store an object in the registry with a specific key.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Check if a specific key exists in the registry.

methods.name: unset
methods.description: Remove a specific key and its associated object from the registry.
